name: com.zplpdf/zpl-to-pdf
title: ZPLPDF — ZPL to PDF
description: Validate, preview and convert ZPL (Zebra) label code to PDF with your ZPLPDF plan quota.

tools.name: validate_zpl
tools.description: Check ZPL syntax and count labels (copies from ^PQ included) without rendering. Free, no API key, no quota.

zpl.description: ZPL code with one or more ^XA … ^XZ label blocks.

tools.name: preview_zpl
tools.description: Render up to 2 unique labels as PNG images to check how they look. No API key needed (rate limited); no quota used.

zpl.description: ZPL code with one or more ^XA … ^XZ label blocks.

labelSize.description: Label size in inches (width x height) or mm: 2x1, 2x4, 4x2, 4x6 (default, shipping labels), 4x8, 50x80mm, 80x50mm.

tools.name: convert_zpl_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert ZPL labels to a PDF (or PNG/JPEG on Pro and above) and return a download URL valid for 15 minutes. Needs an API key with the "mcp" scope; uses 1 PDF of the monthly plan quota. Retrying the same ZPL the same day returns the same file without charging again. If it takes longer than ~25 s, returns a jobId to poll with get_conversion.

zpl.description: ZPL code with one or more ^XA … ^XZ label blocks.

labelSize.description: Label size in inches (width x height) or mm: 2x1, 2x4, 4x2, 4x6 (default, shipping labels), 4x8, 50x80mm, 80x50mm.

format.description: Output format (default pdf). png/jpeg return a ZIP and need Pro or higher.

tools.name: get_conversion
tools.description: Status of a conversion started with convert_zpl_to_pdf, and a fresh download URL when it is completed. Needs an API key.

tools.name: get_account_usage
tools.description: Plan, PDFs left this billing period, labels allowed per PDF and renewal date of the account that owns the API key.
